title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Shivajinagar

content.rendered:
SAMAN Portable manufactures and supplies container offices for sale in Shivajinagar, Bengaluru, building each unit at our own factory in Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. We are a direct manufacturer, not a marketplace or reseller, so a Shivajinagar business buys a brand-new container office straight from the people who weld, panel and finish it. Whether you need a single site cabin for a commercial plot off Shivajinagar Main Road or a larger 40ft modular office for a project team, you order one specification, one price and one point of contact.

Container Offices for Sale in Shivajinagar

A container office for sale in Shivajinagar is a factory-built, ready-to-use office module made on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, fully wired and finished before it leaves our Bengaluru unit. SAMAN Portable delivers it to your Shivajinagar site, places it, and you can start working the same week. You choose the size, the door and window layout, and the interior finish.

Container office sizes we supply

We supply three standard container office sizes, each built to order. All sizes carry the same steel frame, insulated wall and roof panels, electrical points and powder-coated finish.

SizeTypical useFits
10ftSecurity post, single-desk site office, ticket or supervisor cabin1–2 people
20ftProject office, sales office, accounts or HR cabin3–5 people
40ftTeam office, meeting room plus workstations, multi-cabin layout8–12 people

Each unit can be specified with extra windows, a partition, a washroom corner, air-conditioning provision and additional power and data points. Units can also be placed side by side or stacked to create a larger floor area on a compact Shivajinagar plot. For pricing on any size, request a current quote.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying factory-direct means no middleman markup and full control over the build. Here is what every SAMAN container office includes:

  • MS steel frame to IS 2062 — the structural steel meets the recognised Indian standard, so the office stays square, stable and re-locatable.
  • Factory-built at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 — fabricated, panelled, wired and quality-checked under one roof before dispatch.
  • ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturing — a consistent, documented build process on every unit.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life, not a warranty period.)
  • Delivery and returns: standard delivery ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days; returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Because we manufacture in Bengaluru, a Shivajinagar buyer deals with the factory directly for customisation, dispatch timing and after-sales support.

Delivery and installation in Shivajinagar

We deliver container offices across Bengaluru, including Shivajinagar and the surrounding central-city commercial areas. Once your unit is built and quality-checked at Gopasandra, it is loaded and transported to your Shivajinagar address, off-loaded and levelled on your prepared spot. A flat, firm surface with truck access is all that is usually needed; our team confirms the access route and placement before dispatch so a tight commercial site is handled correctly.

Standard delivery is ₹3,000 and typical transit is 3–5 days from dispatch. For a multi-unit or stacked layout we plan the placement sequence in advance so installation on site is quick and clean.

Get a container office quote in Shivajinagar

Tell us the size you need, how many people will use it and any add-ons such as a washroom, partition or air-conditioning, and we will prepare a current quote for delivery to Shivajinagar. To order or to ask a question, call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry on our website. You can also browse our full range and specifications on our container office range.

FAQs


What container office sizes can I buy in Shivajinagar?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices, each built to order. Smaller units suit a security post or single-desk site office, while 20ft and 40ft units work as project, sales or team offices. Units can be combined or stacked for more floor area.


How long does delivery to Shivajinagar take?

Once your unit is built and quality-checked at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru factory, typical transit to a Shivajinagar site is 3–5 days. Standard delivery is ₹3,000. We confirm the access route and placement spot before dispatch.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. You can choose the door and window layout, add a partition, washroom corner, air-conditioning provision and extra power and data points. Because we manufacture in Bengaluru, customisation is arranged directly with the factory.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Every unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How do I get a price for a container office in Shivajinagar?

Prices depend on the size, finish and add-ons you choose, so we quote per order. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your requirement and we will send a current quote for delivery to Shivajinagar.


Are these built on a steel frame?

Yes. Each container office is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062 and manufactured under our ISO 9001:2015 certified process, so the unit stays square, durable and re-locatable.

With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
